name: agy-connectors
description: Zero-install Gemini Enterprise (GE) federated connector bridge for Outlook, SharePoint, OneDrive, Microsoft Teams, Gmail, Google Drive, GitHub, and cost-capped BigQuery.
suggestedPrompts: Run /connect-ge to link my Public Sector Gemini Enterprise instance and test my federated connectors
Search my federated SharePoint, OneDrive, and Outlook via Gemini Enterprise for recent program updates
Run /connect-github-bigquery to configure read-only BigQuery analytics with a 1 GB scan cap
